9.4 Salon Serial

Customer asks: how long is the queue? Owner answers manually all day. Staff forgets order. Regular customers call repeatedly. Walk-ins leave when the wait is unclear.

 9.2 Shop Ledger

Notebook records get lost, buying price is forgotten, customer dues are unclear, and the owner does not know if the day was profitable.

 8.8 Restaurant Table

Customers do not know available items. Staff forget table order details. Owners cannot see which table is active. Kitchen receives messy notes.

 8.5 Pharmacy Stock

Owner forgets expiry dates, staff sells without checking batch, supplier due is scattered, and near-expiry stock becomes dead loss.

Market data

Enough market exists. The hard part is choosing a tiny painful workflow.

These numbers are for possibility planning. The safest strategy is still to validate one area by selling to 10 paying businesses before building deeply.

11.87Meconomic units

Economic Census 2024 reported around 11.87 million economic units. This is the broad pool of shops, services, transport, food, and small operators.

7.8M+CMSMEs

Bangladesh has more than 7.8 million cottage, micro, small, and medium enterprises. This is where low-cost software has the most room.

40%+retail and repair

Wholesale, retail trade, and vehicle repair make up the largest share of economic units. Shop software has the widest base.

436Kfood service units

A BBS hotel-restaurant survey counted 436,274 food-service establishments in 2021, before the latest growth wave.

9.5K+mapped salons

Public map datasets show about 9,570 mapped hair salons. Roadside and informal salons are likely undercounted.

99Kprivate education units

Private education surveys point to nearly 100,000 private education institutions, including coaching centers.

227Klicensed pharmacies

DGDA-linked reporting places licensed pharmacies above 220,000. Pharmacy stock and expiry control is a large vertical.

186Mmobile connections

BTRC March 2026 reporting puts mobile subscriptions above 186 million. Mobile-first distribution is not optional.

01

Salon Serial and Booking System

People hate arriving at a salon and not knowing how many serials are ahead. Owners lose customers when waiting feels uncertain. A QR/public serial page solves a real-life irritation.
